instructions: FPP item (one of 3 interleaved tasks in this chunk -- see START_HERE_2026-09-10.md). Read ONLY the Russian text below and answer ONE factual question -- do not apply any category scheme. Question: does the text ITSELF state that a specific crime, criminal case, investigation, court action, or formal charge has been brought against a named person? 'Yes' requires the text to name or clearly describe such a thing -- a crime, an opened criminal/administrative case, a court decision or sentence, formal charges, or a finding by a prosecutor/oversight body -- directed AT a person. 'No' means the text describes only a resignation, dismissal, removal, term expiration, policy dispute, public statement, or similar political/personnel event, with nothing of that kind stated. 'Unclear' means the TEXT ITSELF is genuinely ambiguous on this specific factual question.
